excerpt.zh: 一场盛大的正式舞会将在观景甲板上举行，沐浴在直射的星光下。这是此次航程中的社交盛事。
excerpt.en: A grand formal ball is to be held on the observation decks, bathed in direct starlight. The social event of the voyage.
